mouth_loop_height: Global maximumZ-minimumZ over the whole curved lip/opening loop. It increases with an arch/corner drop and is NOT an opposing-lip gap or mouth-opening thickness.
profile_samples: Independent near-midline control samples, not a dense evaluated silhouette. The before/after sampling window can select different vertices; use CSV source/local IDs for point correspondence.
source_dimensions: Working-unit authored values, not calibrated dimensions inferred from the original drawings.
geometry_audit: Control polygon fans only; does not certify full subdivided self-intersection, contacts or rig deformation.
